data.description: Settle the design ADR 0050 deferred. Decide: (1) EXPOSURE/AUTH — reuse the opcert pattern (API-Gateway SigV4 -> nginx guard -> loopback-bound rebar-mcp HTTP, proxy verifier) vs a public TLS route + external OAuth AS; which ADR-0050 verifier mode (static/jwt/introspection/proxy/custom); include the required non-loopback-bind + TLS-at-edge acknowledgements. (2) AUTODEPLOY — how to extend ADR 0079 (review-bot-only by construction) to an mcp target: MCP build-context change detection + an MCP /health in-flight drain signal so a redeploy never kills in-flight certified ops, preserving never-touch-gerrit/bounded-blast-radius/rollback. (3) CERTIFIED-OP ROUTING — reconcile 'plan/code/completion certification through the MCP server' with the existing opcert trust gate (ADR 0018/0024/0050). Output: accepted ADR (+ an ADR 0079 amendment). Blocks the infra, autodeploy, and guidance slices.
data.title: ADR: MCP-on-box exposure + auth + autodeploy drain + certified-op routing
